latest_messages.headline: SNPS stopped out −$708 (−7%) on a rate scare — thesis intact, capped by design
latest_messages.body: Our automatic safety net sold Synopsys at $387.50 this morning after a hot jobs report sparked a market-wide rate scare that hit expensive tech. Not company-specific bad news — it goes back on the watch-bench. JPM (+8.75%) and ATI (+0.47%) healthy and protected. No new buys; holding the ~$9.8k proceeds as cash into the long weekend. Account $99,711 (−0.70% today).
